contentHtml:
Term SEO (Search Engine Optimization) I use here in the broadest possible sense. It has never been easier to set up your web site. WordPress platform is in large responsible for this opportunity. Still, to have a successful web site, first, you need to have a great idea and always fresh and high-quality content. That would be your responsibility as a site owner. 

The second most important condition is to follow specific technical rules and to make search engines, Google above all, to notice your work. The ranking is one of the most used words when speaking about the site success.  Achieving top ranking is the process that takes some time. It depends on your commitment and the resources you invest, money, and time. Using paid and free advertising will improve your chances, together with constant site optimization, including posts and images, and improving your site speed.

Service I provide

My job would be to check and suggest improvements in site speed and readability, recognizability to SEO search engines. I work mostly with the blog, portfolio, and corporate web sites.

When writing blog posts, there are some additional rules in addition to those for the regular newspaper articles. That is because the attention span of the average web user is much shorter. Therefore, you need to implement some of these rules.

My Fiverr Gig includes:

  • Yoast WordPress and another necessary Plugin Installation
  • Best Yoast SEO settings configure
  • Complete on-page optimization
  • Pages and posts Optimization
  • Image optimization
  • Optimize Yoast SEO title, headings and meta description
  • Keyword Optimization
  • Social post optimization
  • RSS Feed setup
  • Website Speed Optimization
  • Set up Google Analytics and Google Page Search Engine
  • XML Sitemaps and Robots.txt optimization
  • Add Alt tag to Each Image
  • Add a description to Categories
  • Perform Site health and page speed check and optimization
  • Set up Backup
  • Do minor changes to your theme and
  • Provide written advice on Best Practices applicable to your site

YOAST SEO

The central detail of this endeavor is On-page SEO optimization. On-page SEO is the practice of optimizing individual web pages such as title, URL, meta description, image alt tag, content, etc. Yoast SEO plugin allows you to maximize these factors quickly and precisely. It'll help you to improve your site's visibility, ranking, and organic traffic.

In that regard, I will configure the Yoast SEO plugin and incorporate all applicable on-page optimizations according to Yoast, and search engine terms and conditions. The gig includes editing the text where necessary, setting up the focus keywords, editing snippets, image optimization, and more.

I will also provide a short guide on Yoast SEO rules based on examples from your site. It can help you implement them yourself next time. This gig is an essential part of the process of getting higher ranking and visibility.

Moreover, I will document my work in full, including a detailed On-page SEO report, and Page Speed, GT Matrix, Pingdom, and Google Audit reports.

Additional services

Additionally, we can agree to work together on implementing all applicable suggestions.

It is also a good idea to perform ranking and keyword research, which would be a part of a custom offer.

All of this can be as one time job. Still, I think that some continuous care of your web site is the best solution, and most of my clients accepted this option, giving them a certainty of their site's technical quality and enabling them to focus on the content and readers.

Learn more details about the purpose of this site and my Mission,

Apart from this site, where I offer Courses and Private Lessons, at this moment, I offer services on Upwork and Fiverr. It is also possible to have a direct relationship using Payoneer, or PayPal. If you have some other preferred option for collaboration, please use this contact form for the suggestions.
